parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to obtain the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the WAF instance. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: RuleId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule that you want to query.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection rule template to which the protection rule that you want to query belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-rule --instance-id waf_cdnsdf30000 --template-id 10318 --rule-id 20026192 --defense-type template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --resource rencs000-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi DescribeDefenseRule --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceManagerResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm000q' --InstanceId waf_cdnsdf30000 --RuleId 20026192 --Resource 'rencs000-waf' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DefenseType template --TemplateId 10318
